assertions.assertion: Configuration store calls MigrationsHistoryTable with the schema parameter set to "idscfg"
assertions.rationale: sql.MigrationsHistoryTable("__EFMigrationsHistory", "idscfg") passes idscfg as the schema argument.

assertions.assertion: Operational store calls MigrationsHistoryTable with the schema parameter set to "idsop"
assertions.rationale: sql.MigrationsHistoryTable("__EFMigrationsHistory", "idsop") passes idsop as the schema argument.
